hooks.command: bash -c 'JAVAC="/c/Program Files/Zulu/zulu-25/bin/javac"; JAVA="/c/Program Files/Zulu/zulu-25/bin/java"; echo "=== Verificando compilacao (warnings como erros) ==="; mkdir -p build/classes && "$JAVAC" --release 24 -Xlint:all -Werror -d build/classes $(find src -name "*.java") 2>&1; COMPILE=$?; echo "=== Validando i18n ==="; "$JAVAC" tools/I18nValidator.java -d tools 2>&1 && "$JAVA" -cp tools I18nValidator 2>&1; I18N=$?; if [ $COMPILE -ne 0 ] || [ $I18N -ne 0 ]; then echo "FALHOU: corrija os erros acima antes de commitar"; exit 1; fi; echo "Tudo OK!"'
